text: Buy a tiny cactus. Name it Greg. Protect him.
Send a random emoji to a friend. Let chaos unfold.
Eat one grape. Meditate on its sphere.
Put a sticky note on your mirror: 'We ride at dawn.'
Tell your pillow your deepest secret. It already knows.
Rename your WiFi to 'I can see you.'
Become a blanket burrito. Ascend.
Stare at a spoon until it gets uncomfortable.
Text yourself 'we need to talk' and panic.
Put googly eyes on your food. Make friends.
Walk backwards for exactly 47 steps today.
Name all your pens. Have favorites.
Whisper 'thank you' to your fridge. It works hard.
Draw a tiny crown. You're royalty now.
Compliment a tree. It's having a rough season.
Save a meme. Never look at it again.
Count to potato. You'll know when you get there.
Make intense eye contact with your reflection. Who blinks first?
Put on socks. Take them off. Repeat until enlightened.
Ask your plants if they're okay. Listen carefully.
Delete one app. Panic. Reinstall immediately.
Declare today 'backwards day' but don't tell anyone.
Put a coin in your shoe. Experience discomfort willingly.
Wave at a stranger's window. Drive away slowly.
Spell your name backwards. That's your wizard name now.
Buy the fancy cheese. You deserve tiny luxuries.
Narrate your morning routine like a nature documentary.
Hold your breath until you remember why you walked into this room.
Put a sticky note that says 'LATER' on your to-do list.
Reorganize one drawer. Feel disproportionately accomplished.
Smile at a bird. It won't smile back but try anyway.
Declare war on dust. You will lose but fight bravely.
Put your phone in airplane mode. You're grounded.
Make a tiny paper hat for your thumb. Thumb president.
Say 'beep boop' when you're thinking. Confuse everyone.
Reorganize your apps by vibe only. No logic.
Draw a mustache on a banana. Sophisticated snack.
Walk like you're in a music video. Own the grocery store.
Give your houseplant a pep talk. It needs encouragement.
Set an alarm for 3:33. See what happens. (Nothing will.)
Put your important papers in the freezer. They're safe now.
Wear mismatched socks on purpose. Chaos with style.
Create a conspiracy theory about pigeons. They know.
Type gibberish into a search engine. Embrace confusion.
Stand in your closet. Pretend you're in Narnia.
Make a vision board but only with pictures of bread.
Put a 'Do Not Disturb' sign on your bedroom door. You live alone.
Challenge a rock to a staring contest. Lose gracefully.
Write a strongly worded letter to your past self. Don't send it.
Befriend a local crow. Bring shiny offerings.
Whisper your WiFi password to strangers. Assert dominance.
Put a single googly eye on every appliance.
Dance like nobody's watching because nobody is. They're on their phones.
Name your car. Apologize when you hit a pothole.
Build a pillow fort. Defend it with your life.
Leave cryptic notes for yourself. 'The duck knows.'
Pretend you're a spy. Your mission: buy milk inconspicuously.
Do one thing today that makes zero sense. Live boldly.
Paint a rock. Leave it somewhere random. It's art now.
Have a serious conversation with your rubber duck.
Alphabetize your snacks. Judge them harshly.
Walk around your house like you're shopping for a new one.
Create a playlist called 'Songs to Overthink To'. Listen on repeat.
Put a plant in an unusual place. Windowsill is too basic.
Make a sandwich. Admire it before eating. It's temporary art.
Pretend every doorway is a portal. Step through dramatically.
Organize your bookshelf by color. Chaos disguised as aesthetic.
Set a timer for 7 minutes. Do absolutely nothing. Master it.
Nice. Just... nice.
Put a tiny umbrella in your drink. You're fancy now.
Talk to yourself in third person all day. [Name] is thriving.
Buy unnecessary amount of Post-its. You'll find a use. Maybe.
Rearrange your furniture at 2am. The feng shui called to you.
Make a pros and cons list for becoming a lighthouse keeper.
Put a rubber band around your wrist. Snap it when you have a thought.
Create an elaborate backstory for a random object you own.
Sit in a different chair than usual. Experience the chaos.
Draw a map of your house from memory. You've lived here how long?
Pretend you're being interviewed about your morning routine.
Make your bed immediately after waking up. Who are you becoming?
Put a small object in your pocket. Forget about it. Be surprised later.
Google yourself. Be disappointed. We all are.
Rearrange your desktop icons into a smiley face. Productivity!
Wave at security cameras. They're lonely too.
Create a very specific Spotify playlist: 'Songs for Eating Cheese at 3pm'.
Talk to your pet in a British accent. They'll be confused but intrigued.
Put your clothes on in a different order. Start with socks.
Make a list of things you're the best in the world at. 'Napping' counts.
Stand in your shower fully clothed. Question your choices.
Buy a plant. Name it after your enemy. Watch it thrive.
Eat breakfast for dinner. Time is a construct anyway.
Put your phone on grayscale mode. Experience the void.
Make a paper airplane. Throw it at your problems.
Wear a cape to do mundane tasks. Laundry is heroic now.
Start a journal. Write one entry. Never open it again.
Put a 'Sold Out' sign on your forehead. You're unavailable.
Make a time capsule. Open it next Tuesday.
Pretend you're a food critic. Review your cereal harshly.
Walk into a room. Forget why. Leave. Remember. Repeat.
Buy a rubber duck. It's your new therapist. Cheaper too.
